gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Technical from the first glance, Nippo draws its o with sides and top equally thick; Noto Sans Tagalog opens its curves. Its dominant middle zone fills each line, so paragraphs move along steadily.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Spaghetti laid out as letters: that is Nippo. Nippo does its best work grabbing attention up top, while Noto Sans Tagbanwa quietly fills the lines below with open curves.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads softly, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch, under a Nippo heading that glides like wire. That wire-like glide against tapered text is what stands out.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham reads like chalk-board lowercase pushed toward the capital line. Nippo brings sign-shop vinyl lines cut to a single width, and beneath them the body fills each line with clearly open round forms.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Short ascenders and a tall x-height make the text approachable, while the Nippo heading looks drawn with a round-tipped pen. Noto Sans Tai Viet carries a long paragraph smoothly, its terminals pulled back from each curve.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-takri: Bent-paperclip letters in Nippo, with no stroke swelling at all. Noto Sans Takri sets a high-waisted lowercase with generously unclosed rounds, so extended text moves along with room to breathe.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Nippo draws a stencil-cut channel of constant weight. Beneath it, Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing, terminals stopping far from the stem, and that tension is the pair's best quality.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tamil-suppleme: Smooth, unpinched curves make Nippo a sharp attention-grabber up top. And Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, with round forms like open parentheses and a stocky middle band, is built for filling lines below.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide and inviting, while the Nippo heading keeps one constant line width. Short ascender stems keep a lengthy read tidy and friendly.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC leaves large open counters in its tall letters, with curves that flare outward rather than curling in. Noto Sans TC does the quiet work of carrying text, leaving Nippo to supply the wire-bent sign look.
